question: Which type of natural vegetation is found in the Ganges-Brahmaputra delta?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mangrove trees**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Mangrove trees** are the type of natural vegetation found in the Ganges-Brahmaputra delta.
 
• The Ganges-Brahmaputra delta, also known as the Sundarbans, is famous for its dense mangrove forests.
